title: StackTrace
description: A parsed, language-agnostic representation of an exception/stack trace.

id.description: Unique identifier for this stack trace (UUID).

language.description: Detected source language of the trace.

raw_trace.description: The original unparsed stack trace text.

frames.description: Ordered stack frames, typically innermost (failure point) first.

file.description: File path as it appears in the trace.

code_snippet.description: The line of source code at this frame, if included in the trace.

is_application_code.description: True if this frame belongs to the user's codebase rather than a third-party library/framework.

related_log_ids.description: IDs of LogEntry records surrounding this stack trace, for additional context.
